categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the production and sales of high-temperature and high-performance alloys, high-quality special stainless steels, and other special alloy products. Its product portfolio includes deformation high-temperature alloys, ultra-high purity stainless steels, corrosion-resistant alloys, ultra-high strength alloys, precision alloys, and high-quality special stainless steels, serving aerospace, gas turbines, nuclear engineering, petrochemical, and other military and civilian high-end equipment manufacturing sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies such as high-return ratio recycled alloy preparation, vacuum induction melting, vacuum arc remelting, vacuum consumable melting, and large-scale forging. It has proprietary technologies for high-purity alloy smelting, automated pollution-free alloy scrap pretreatment, and precise control of alloy composition and microstructure. The company also employs short-process preparation methods to significantly reduce production cycles and costs while improving material purity and performance.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major military and civilian aerospace manufacturers, gas turbine and steam turbine producers, nuclear engineering firms, petrochemical companies, and other high-end equipment manufacturers. The company maintains long-term supply relationships with leading military industrial groups and prominent domestic enterprises in aviation, aerospace, and energy sectors. It also serves international clients including GE, Honeywell, and Schlumberger.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with significant sales concentrated in East China, Southwest China, North China, Northwest China, Northeast China, Central China, and South China regions. It has begun expanding its international business with certified products exported to countries such as Italy and India, and cooperation with global industry leaders.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily upstream and midstream in the supply chain as a producer of strategic high-performance alloy materials and special stainless steels. It supplies critical raw and semi-finished materials to downstream manufacturers of aerospace engines, gas turbines, nuclear reactors, and petrochemical equipment.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing high-return recycled alloy technologies, import substitution of key strategic materials, and development of new high-performance alloy grades. R&D focuses on aerospace-grade high-temperature alloys, corrosion-resistant alloys for oil wells, ultra-high strength steels, precision alloys, and high-purity special stainless steels. The company emphasizes innovation in alloy composition control, manufacturing processes, and digital twin service systems to enhance product quality and cost efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of alloy products in various forged forms such as bars, plates, discs, rings, and shafts. The company employs a direct sales model supplemented by trade agents, with production closely aligned to sales orders and safety stock policies. Additional income arises from government subsidies and investment returns.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic producer and the only one in China to industrialize high-return recycled high-temperature alloy technology with international advanced standards. It holds a competitive position in import substitution for key alloy grades and maintains certifications and supply relationships with major military and civilian customers. The company faces increasing competition as the high-performance alloy market grows but leverages its technological and quality advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.51 billion, a 23.29% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 161.58 million, up 7.14%. Total assets reached RMB 3.7 billion, with net assets of RMB 1.86 billion, reflecting strong growth and expanding scale. The company maintains positive cash flow from operations and has increased R&D investment steadily.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through proprietary high-return recycled alloy technology that reduces costs by about 30%, improves material purity and performance, and shortens production cycles. It offers a broad product range with high customization to meet stringent aerospace and nuclear standards. Its closed-loop recycling system ensures strategic resource security and defense information confidentiality, providing customers with reliable, high-quality, and cost-effective alloy solutions.
